verdict.rationale: HubSpot's marketing product page says its built-in AI can rewrite nurture emails for each contact using CRM data, behavior and company research, so the platform's own AI does refine email copy. That is per-recipient personalization rather than drafting from a brief, and the editor docs only describe setting the subject line manually. Missing for 10: AI drafting from a brief, AI subject-line generation, an AI assistant documented inside the email composer, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can have the platform's built-in AI draft or refine subject lines and email copy from a brief, inside the composer

citations.quote: Rewrite every nurture email for the specific contact receiving it, using their CRM data, behavior, and live company research.
